title: Asiad: Malaysia ends Sibol Identity V medal bid with 2-0 sweep
summary: Sibol Identity V medal bid came to an end after falling to Malaysia, 0-2, in the quarterfinals of the 2026 Asian Games on Wednesday at the Aichi-Sky Expo Hall.
